item.title: DOJ launches antitrust probe of TV networks. And, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader
item.description: The Justice Department is investigating several TV networks for possible antitrust violations. And, President Trump pressures Ukrainians to elect a new leader.

item.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are leaving police departments in the lurch
item.description: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
item.description: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.
item.content:encoded: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

item.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

item.title: Hurricane Simon pounds resorts and vulnerable towns along Mexico's Pacific coast
item.description: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.
